title: Should You Put Your Address on a Resume?
description:
Putting your address on a resume used to be a staple in the traditional world of job seeking. However, in today's day and age, with the possibility of remote and hybrid jobs, this practice may no longer be helpful in your search. On this episode of the Teal Podcast, we discuss whether it's necessary to put your physical mailing address on your resume.
